# Start the guided build tool

This optional path helps you shape and build a stronger hackathon project without leaving Step 3: Resources.

You will start with a quick onboarding — two or three questions asked together, starting with whether you already have an idea of what you want to build today. Answer in one go, and Codex will offer a couple more questions only if you want them before moving on.

Useful personalization can include your name, your project idea, and your coding background. Those details can appear in later guidance so the flow feels specific to your project rather than static.

Output: learner profile notes and the next command, `$build-scope`.
